title: Elective Sign-Up at Ridgeline High
introduction: The gym is a maze of folding tables, the line stretches out the door and past the vending machine, and the counselor abandoned alphabetical order an hour ago. Somewhere near the robotics table a clipboard has gone missing, and nobody is willing to say who last had it.
preamble:
Five students are involved. Determine each student's birthday month and elective.
- **Student**: Darnell, Linnea, Omar, Mateo and Trey.
- **Birthday month** (listed from earlier to later): January, February, March, April and May.
- **Elective**: Spanish, digital art, robotics, wood shop and theater tech.
Every student has a different birthday month and elective, so within each category every item is used exactly once.
clues: Trey was born exactly one month before February, with no birthday month in between, and Mateo was born exactly one month before April, with no birthday month in between.
The student who signs up for Spanish was not born in February, and was born exactly one month away from Mateo, in one direction or the other.
The student who signs up for digital art was born exactly one month before Linnea, with no birthday month in between.
Omar was not born in April, and the student who signs up for robotics was born earlier in the year than Omar.
Omar was born earlier in the year than the student who signs up for wood shop.
